name: Vietnam Open
stakes: This week at the Vietnam Open offered a vital platform for India's rising badminton stars to gain international experience and make a mark on the BWF Tour.
summary:
The Vietnam Open has wrapped up, with India's Isharani Baruah delivering a standout performance by reaching her first-ever BWF Tour final. The third seed, ranked 39th, ultimately faced a tough challenge from Thailand's unseeded Sarunrak Vitidsarn, falling in straight games. Despite the loss, this run marks a significant milestone for Baruah, signaling her growing presence on the international circuit and offering a glimpse of her promising future.

Elsewhere in the tournament, veteran HS Prannoy's campaign in the Men's Singles concluded in the semifinals, where he was aiming for his first final of the season. The event also highlighted the depth of India's women's singles talent, with Rakshitha and Tanvi Sharma both making impressive runs to the semifinals. Malvika Bansod also advanced to the quarterfinals, where she was eliminated by compatriot Tanvi Sharma. While a title eluded the contingent, the tournament provided crucial experience and competitive exposure for several Indian players.
